data.description: The sprint workflow SKILL.md is a megalithic 18+ phase file that interleaves context gathering, sub-agent dispatch, gate checks, and result application. oz-for-oss (https://github.com/warpdotdev/oz-for-oss/blob/main/docs/platform.md) splits each role into three explicit helpers — gather GitHub context, build prompt, apply result — sharing only lifecycle plumbing. Porting this shape would shrink the sprint SKILL.md, make per-phase behavior testable in isolation, and reduce the amount of prompt-construction logic that has to live as natural-language instructions to the orchestrator. Scope: prototype the triad pattern on 2-3 sprint phases (likely Phase E story branch creation, Phase F merge, Phase 6 completion verification), measure SKILL.md token reduction and orchestrator reliability, then plan rollout.
data.title: Refactor sprint SKILL.md into (context + prompt + apply) per phase
